issues.rework_note: Round 1: agent initially advertised conditionally_independent=true for all Gray QAM presets, which is wrong for 16/64/256-QAM where multi-bit PAM axes violate per-symbol conditional independence (posterior does not factor except at y=0). Split PRESET_ANALYSIS into BPSK_QPSK_ANALYSIS (all true) and QAM_MULTI_BIT_AXIS_ANALYSIS (conditionally_independent=false), added per-preset ModemView round-trip tests + reference-mapper/demapper exposure test, tightened invariant 9 to require exact analysis length match. Round 2: doc on BitChannelAnalysis::conditionally_independent field still claimed the property holds for Gray QAM, contradicting the now-correct flags; rewrote docstring to explicitly call out the higher-order QAM limitation.

issues.title: Implement fast Gray square-QAM soft demapper
issues.rework_note: Round 1: zero-gain emitted NaN + pam_axis_llr duplicated subset reduction from ref_demapper. Added zero-gain guard emitting zero LLRs, extracted subset_log_map_llr into modem/demapper.rs, added proptest. Round 2: constructor accepted custom builder specs with spoofed metadata but non-preset I-geometry. Added I-axis factorisation assertion. Round 3: Q-axis had the same validation gap. Added Q-axis factorisation assertion + Q-axis-spoofing regression test. Round 4: set-equality between I and Q axes was insufficient — a permuted Q-label mapping passed set equality but broke the kernel's reuse of pam_levels for both axes. Tightened to require per-label mapping equality. Round 5: BPSK branch did not validate label order or common-Q assumption the kernel relies on. Added explicit checks (label 0 at index 0, label 1 at index 1, both points share Q coordinate) + two regression tests.
